recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The current core Specimen model, terminology, and examples now align with the published FHIR-22838 decision; any future THO migration or terminology URL policy work should be tracked separately outside this core reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-22838 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. The accepted OO motion added Specimen.combined as a 0..1 grouped|pooled code, added Specimen.role as a 0..* CodeableConcept with a preferred specimen-role value set derived from v2 table 0369 without H/G/L, requested related terminology/examples, and clarified the then-current ServiceRequest.specimen comment.
initial_application: Commit 3f94a76ece added the Specimen elements, specimen-combined/specimen-role CodeSystem and ValueSet sources, examples, and the ServiceRequest.specimen comment. Commit 5cef2d9 corrected Specimen.role short/definition text. The current source retained the substantive model changes but still had copied metadata: Specimen.combined used PublicationStatus/common-binding metadata, and the specimen-role CodeSystem description said it provided combined status.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Specimen and ServiceRequest as active OO resources, placing the edited Specimen XML files in current build scope. Later applied R6 issues FHIR-34206, FHIR-48286, and FHIR-55444 deprecated and then removed ServiceRequest.specimen, so the absence of the old FHIR-22838 ServiceRequest.comment is intentional later source history. OO minutes confirm the FHIR-22838 motion and later note that the value set was in the build for ballot while THO migration was a separate vocabulary follow-up.
reconciliation: Changed source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml so Specimen.combined uses the SpecimenCombined binding name and no longer carries the copied common-binding marker. Changed source/specimen/codesystem-specimen-role.xml so the CodeSystem description describes specimen role rather than combined status.
source_changes: source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml: corrected Specimen.combined binding metadata from PublicationStatus/common-binding to SpecimenCombined.
source/specimen/codesystem-specimen-role.xml: corrected the specimen-role CodeSystem description to describe specimen role.
